text: {"assertions":["A bug in analytics/dashboards/funnel.py caused missing steps in the funnel report.","The missing step bug only affected tenants with more than ten thousand distinct keys.","The root cause was a mutable default argument being shared across function calls.","The bug was fixed by creating an empty default and building the value per call in PR #2934 on the fix/missing-step-1 branch.","The backlog cleared 90 minutes after the fix was deployed to production.","The funnel analytics code is written in Python.","The bug was reproduced by building a funnel for a two-week window, which showed a stage with zero users between two populated stages.","The fix is covered by tests in tests/analytics/test_funnel.py."]}
